description.value: Super Grocer is a long-standing neighbourhood supermarket in Richmond's Steveston area, serving the community since at least the 1970s. It stocks groceries, dairy, meats, and produce, and shares the building complex with an in-house pharmacy and flower shop. Its location between Moncton and Chatham Streets makes it a convenient supply stop for cyclists touring the Steveston waterfront.
